bundle.self: Select an Appropriate Threshold for Multisig Wallets Multisignature requirements for privileged actions SHOULD have a sufficient number of signers, and NOT require "1 of N" nor all signatures.
bundle.parent_section_context: This section describes good practices that require substantial human judgement to evaluate, where there isn't a clear way to determine if it has been done or not, or where a poor implementation can reduce rather than increase the security of the Tested Code. Testing for, and meeting these requirements does not directly affect conformance to this document. Note however that meeting the Recommended Good Practice [GP] Meet as Many Requirements as Possible will in practice mean that Tested Code meets all the Requirements based on Compiler Bugs, including the majority of Requirements for Security Level [S].
